turns.content: Not great. I'm feeling pretty down in the dumps.
Im sorry to hear that. how can I help
I'm not sure how, exactly. I'm dealing with repeated rejections.
That is always tough especially during this time of year and been there myself.
What type of rejection  are you experiencing
Romantic rejection. It seems like every time I make an effort, it's immediately shot down.
I hate to ask you this but are you male or female?
I ask it changes the perception on how I may help you because male and females deal with things differently.
Fair enough. What do you suggest I try?
I am going to ask you a few questions if OK i don't want to sound like i am prying.
That's fine. I'm open to discussion.

turns.text: Hello
hello
How may i help you today?
I've been sad. My dog died
I am sorry I know exactly how you are feeling I have had a dog that i loved more than anything die couple years ago
Sorry to hear that. I just watched a movie that had a dog that looked like mine in it. It upset me
What movie was it?
I don't remember the name of the movie, but it was about some kids trying to find homes for dogs that a shelter was closing before Christmas
Oh ok how did your dog die was something wrong with him or just old age?
She was old, blind and was getting dog dementia. I had to have her put to sleep
I am really sorry that has got to be the worst feeling putting your dog to sleep
It is. At least I was able to be with her so she wasn't afraid.
I just think of it this way your dog is in dog heaven and is watching over you that is how i think of it even though it really aint true thats just how i think
My dog died of old age
it took me like 2 or 3 weeks to get over it and not cry for once
I just miss her. I believe she is with her brother. He died 7 years ago. He was hit by a car.
I can understand that
I can understand how you feeling but everything will be okay and it is ok to miss her
I was doing pretty good then there was this dog in the movie and I just broke down again.
I understand I would break down to if I saw that
Just do something you like to do to get your mind off of it
It helps to have a person to talk to. I used this chat Hit before right after I had to put her to sleep. The person I talked to then had a dog too.
Right it is always good to have someone to talk to in a situation like that
It's a good Idea to do something to get my mind off of it.
Just by expressing your feelings with someone will help a lot to
Yes it helps.
Maybe you can watch a comedy movie or another kind of movie to get your mind off of it
That sounds like a good idea. A comedy probably would help
yes it would help. Keep your head up and know your dog is dog heaven and not suffering anymore.
Okay. Thanks for talking. Goodnight.
your welcome goodnight
